summary.text: Edgar Flores is a Democratic state senator from Nevada who has represented District 2 since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; he is an attorney who earlier served in the Nevada State Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Flores earned a bachelor's degree in English and a juris doctor from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, and has worked as an attorney.
He served in Nevada State Assembly District 28 from 2014 to 2022 and assumed his Senate seat on November 9, 2022.

In the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Senate Government Affairs Committee, vice chair of the Senate Judiciary Committee and a member of the Senate Commerce and Labor Committee.
